about: A widely published author, frequent lecturer and highly respected Family Law attorney, Keith Nelson is a name partner in the law offices of Orsinger, Nelson, Downing & Anderson, LLP, one of the largest and most respected Family Law firms in the Southwest. Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Nelson has specific expertise in topics including the psychological aspects in divorce and custody matters, jurisdiction, custody, visitation, common-law marriage and Amicus Attorney arrangements. Nelson is particularly interested in issues involving children and has extensive experience in addressing the psychological impact of custody and divorce litigation on children and their parents.
